evidence_quotes: Projectplan op grond van de Waterwet.
Eisers vinden het onredelijk dat het projectplan niet voorziet in een betonnen damwand.
rationale: The decision reviews a project plan adopted pursuant to the Dutch Water Act (Projectplan op grond van de Waterwet) by the executive board (het college) regarding waterworks infrastructure and claimants' demand for a concrete sheet pile wall (betonnen damwand). This falls squarely within substantive water governance and specifically waterboard project-plan governance (waterboard_governance), with no household service connection or informal settlement issue.
